target.title: Add bulk price update endpoint
target.description:
Lets the pricing team apply a percentage change to every item at once,
for example factor=1.05 for a 5% increase.

summary: Adds a new bulk price update endpoint that applies a percentage factor to all items in the database.

evidence.note: The new bulk_update_prices endpoint uses @require_login instead of @require_role('staff') or @require_role('admin')
Other mutation endpoints like create_item use @require_role('staff')

arguments.claim: The bulk price update endpoint at /items/bulk-price only requires authentication via @require_login instead of checking for privileged roles like staff or admin, allowing any authenticated user to modify item prices.
arguments.explanation: The newly added bulk price update endpoint (`POST /items/bulk-price`) uses only `@require_login`, which permits any authenticated user (including customers) to modify prices across the entire database. Other modification and sensitive endpoints in `app/routes/items.py` correctly require elevated permissions via `@require_role("staff")` or `@require_role("admin")`.
